summary.text: Vincent Cox is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 85, which the House page lists as representing Jefferson Parish, and was first elected in 2023. His official House page lists him on the Administration of Criminal Justice, Commerce, and Municipal, Parochial and Cultural Affairs committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Cox's occupation as retired network technical specialist at AT&T.
It lists his education as Archbishop Shaw High School, 1977.
He is also listed in the Jefferson Parish Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.

sources.title: Vincent E. Cox, III, District 85 (Louisiana House of Representatives)
